title: ...prep your vehicle for a major road trip
desc: Prevent highway breakdowns and ensure passenger safety before long drives.
todos: Check tire pressure (including spare) and verify adequate tread depth.
Inspect engine oil, coolant, brake fluid, and windshield washer levels.
Test headlights, brake lights, turn signals, and windshield wipers.
Pack emergency kit with jumper cables, flashlight, first aid, and water.
Confirm roadside assistance coverage details and save hotline number.
